name: dai_conservation
informal: Sum dai[u] == debt — no Dai created from thin air. Every dai balance change is matched by an equal change to debt.
notes: Ghost accumulator ghost_sumDai tracks Sum dai[u]. Checked-arithmetic abstraction of Vat math (semantically equivalent, solver-tractable). 5 VCs proved safe by CHC/z3. Vacuity confirmed: mutated assert(ghost_sumDai == debt + 1) yields counterexample.

name: debt_solvency
informal: debt == vice + Sum_i(Art_i * rate_i) — every Dai is backed by a CDP or accounted as system bad debt.
notes: Ghost accumulator ghost_sumArtRate tracks Sum_i(Art_i * rate_i) via deltas. frob/fold change debt and ghost equally; grab transfers between vice and ghost; heal/suck change debt and vice equally. 6 VCs proved safe. Vacuity confirmed.

name: sin_conservation
informal: Sum sin[u] == vice — system bad debt accounting is conservative.
notes: Ghost accumulator ghost_sumSin tracks Sum sin[u]. grab/heal/suck each change sin[w] and vice by identical amounts. 4 VCs proved safe. Vacuity confirmed.

name: fee_monotonic
informal: fold with non-negative rate delta never decreases debt — backed debt only grows when rates increase.
notes: Pre-state snapshot of debt; verbatim Vat fold logic with require(rate_delta >= 0). Art >= 0 (uint) and rate_delta >= 0 implies rad >= 0 implies debt_new >= debt_old. 1 VC proved safe. Vacuity confirmed with mutated assert(debt < debt_old) yielding counterexample.
